background: Shawbrook is a UK specialist lender owned by private equity, funded by retail and business savings and lending on buy-to-let and specialist residential mortgages, commercial property, and to smaller companies through asset and structured finance.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the bank. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter against a 13.9% median, while leverage of 8.7% is in the top quarter against 7.4%. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 157% below the 172% median and NSFR of 126% in the bottom quarter against 135%. The trend is the point: since 31 Dec 2023 LCR has fallen 154 points and NSFR 20 points, so a large liquidity surplus has been used to grow the book, while CET1 has been flat and leverage has risen 0.5 points. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
